title: Oldie Bicep Workout
author: Old Lady wants Shred
desc: This bicep workout program is for individuals looking to enhance their upper arm strength and improve muscle definition. Over the course of 8 weeks you will engage in exercises that promote muscle growth and endurance, tailored to suit beginners and those with more experience. Join us to sculpt stronger, more defined arms with a program that balances challenge with achievable progress!!

ex.note: Cool down for 5 minutes and stretch biceps, forearms, and shoulders to aid in recovery and flexibility.
Stand on the band with feet shoulder-width apart , holding the ends with both hands. Curl your hands up towards shoulders, keep elbows stationary by your side.
Perform a regular bicep curl, and at the top of the movement, rotate your wrists so palms are face downwards and slowly lower the weights in this reverse curl position.
